method: Inspected both final Penpot PNG exports, checked native gradient stops, and sampled the exported highlight to confirm that its intensity decreases upward.
findings: The independent cursor is visibly layered over the bar, with an eyelet above, an ivory-edged dark line crossing the channel and a recognizable anchor at its bottom.
All eight precision areas sit inside the channel, reach its bottom edge and taper upward. The old under-bar brackets are absent.
Each precision area is a native path with an editable four-stop gradient, decreasing from0.62 opacity at the bottom to0 at the top. Text and icons remain above the gradient.

Exported centre pixels below the Fish label progressively lighten upward: RGB201,172,119 at y230;210,184,136 at y222;218,195,151 at y214;221,198,157 at y210. This confirms a fade rather than a flat solid triangle.
Labels, icons, marker, anchor and Stop control remain readable and unclipped. No active-tag fill has been introduced.
scope: Static Penpot design verification only; no Unity integration or gameplay/motion implementation.
